comparison: All canonical keys searched at 1886 entries; information-domain principles and adjacent computational cards inspected. Parent formal01 additions included. No central files mutated.

records.observation: The iid estimator is phi_1/n. The primary study explicitly contrasts it with dependent Markov observations, where it can remain biased. Only the iid operation is counted; windowed variants are not new cards.

Coalition-size factorial weights equal averaging each marginal contribution over all player permutations. The card uses the general cooperative-game operation and does not add feature-attribution or sampling variants.

The official Stanford chapter gives welfare maximization and payment as others' optimal welfare absent the agent minus others' welfare under the chosen allocation. Quasilinear private values and exact allocation optimization are retained.

records.locator: Appendix B.1 equation B.1; supporting explicit bounds B.6
records.observation: For 0<=a<=A and 0<=b<=B, lifted c obeys c>=0, c>=Ab+Ba-AB, c<=Ab, c<=Ba. This single-product convex hull does not enforce c=ab when optimized in a larger relaxed model.

The author defines q(x,y)=p(x,y)h(y)/h(x) for a nonnegative harmonic h on its positive domain and derives endpoint-ratio path weights. Conditional interpretation is separately justified for appropriate hitting functions.
Independent identically distributed cycle-duration/reward pairs and finite expectations yield long-run reward rate E(R)/E(X). This is not the average of individual cycle ratios.

records.locator: Sections 1.6–1.8; spread density and inspection paradox
records.observation: Equilibrium time inspection weights a lifetime density by x/E(X). The observation mechanism differs from cycle reward aggregation; it changes which intervals enter a sample.

records.locator: Section II equations 4–6; Section III equation 21
records.observation: Crossing intensity integrates absolute velocity against the joint value/velocity density evaluated at the level; positive velocities give upcrossings. The primary paper treats differentiable inertial processes, not raw nondifferentiable Brownian paths.

Service guarantees compose by infimal convolution beta1 tensor beta2. Arrival/service curve deviations bound backlog and virtual delay; successive latency-rate servers add latencies and take the minimum rate.

The density process exp(integral A dB minus half integral A squared dt) changes measure; B minus integral A dt becomes Brownian. The source explicitly requires a true martingale, not merely a local one.

records.locator: Slides 7–10, stabilizing-controller construction and iff theorem
records.observation: Doubly coprime factors satisfying the Bezout matrix identity yield Ur=Yl-Mr Q and Vr=Xl-Nr Q, with K=Ur Vr inverse. Stable Q, properness and denominator invertibility are required; factor order and feedback convention matter.

records.locator: Rays in wave propagation, PDF pages 10–12
records.observation: The exponential-phase times amplitude-series ansatz produces the eikonal equation at leading order and amplitude transport next. Turning-point connection is discussed earlier in the notes. Different media are not separate operations.

records.locator: Slides 86–95: Poincare map, periodic-orbit stability and transverse derivative
records.observation: P(y)=flow at return time tau(y) maps a transversal section to itself; fixed points correspond to periodic orbits. Its derivative removes the flow direction from monodromy. No full delay-coordinate state reconstruction is involved.

records.locator: Slides 2–8: center/stable split, invariant graph and approximation
records.observation: For zero-real-part center eigenvalues and negative-real-part remaining modes, z=h(y) obeys A2h+g2-Dh(A1y+g1)=0. Substitution gives reduced nonlinear dynamics. Local spectral and tangency assumptions are included.

The paper recalls converting an oscillatory primitive to a first-order auxiliary ODE, then evaluates endpoint differences. Its singularity modifications are not separate cards. Theorem 2.6 explicitly equates suitable-basis Filon and Levin rules.
